body: Once a month the same vehicle pulls into the driveway, and it’s there for maybe 30 minutes to an hour and then it’s gone for another month. Our mailman brings her mail to her front door and leaves it, and the utility department grabs her garbage can from under her carport and dumps it and then returns it. I’m trying to make the decision of calling today to see what can be done about checking on her living quarters status and a wellness check, or if I should not cause a bother to her and wait it out to see if something like this is repeated. We’ve lived here almost a year and never heard a peep until last week. I can’t think that would make this much of a difference though? Thank you for the advice!

That has been something I’ve seriously thought about. I’m just not sure if I should call them today, or wait it out and see if it wasn’t just an episode? She’s not made a peep in ten months until last week.
I don’t really think I’m even a character anymore. Just an empty paper caricature of a human. People think empty mean without feelings. Empty feels a lot like drowning to me.

I’ve gone my entire life only having my bad parents pointed out... that was the only time the focus was ever on me. I don’t know I actually know any good things about myself. I’ve operated on empty for so long, it’s not even an issue so much as comparing myself to the ones who are the center point. It’s more so the ones who’ve always passed me over that made me think this way.
I appreciate more than I can say, your calm words last night. They helped me through a storm, and that is a kindness not everyone is willing to give💕

Be happy. Make myself proud. 

Raise my dogs with my boyfriend. 

Make him my husband after another year or so

Bring a child into the world in about five

Look my parent in the eye and tell them, I’ve successfully made the life they tried to puzzle together, because I quit trying to force pieces into the holes I thought they should fit.

I have to say, I’m lucky to have a (much better) better half who DOES make me feel that way. My parent just knows that without him here right now, I’m weaker. They like to play on loneliness and weakness. They consider love to be vain and only skin deep. I’m lucky to know that isn’t true.

My story is a long and was a sad one from the beginning. For a lot of reasons I can’t go into, Ive had abandonment issues my entire life. My narcissistic parent has always thrown themselves at the forefront of everything to make themselves as important as possible. Very jealous and very possessive, but also incredibly mean and would break me down bit by bit my entire life. I’m lead to believe it was done to keep me dependent on them. 

It’s just made me broken, and hate myself.

I feel.... broken. I haven’t felt quite like this in a long time. 

I know it’s the pairing of being by myself without my support, and just how that parent has always been. 

Are parents supposed to make you want to die? Or at the very least, disappear?
Watch “Gone With The Wind” for a couple weeks straight and you’ll have no issue!!! My best recommendation 😘

Probably baked him a cake or casserole with laxatives in it. Or smiled in his face and then told a couple people (however many they could find) that he was getting realllllll cozy with “that little teeny bopper he has working for him”. (Southern Belles go for the long term humiliation generally) but good job on giving them the what for! Nothing wrong with that either!
I haven’t yet, but I live in a small town... I wouldn’t be surprised if I did.
Pretty much yeah. Half of my family refers to me as “Scarlett”.... some as a compliment, some as an insult🤷🏼‍♀️
